'''Hiakk Hall''' was a [[Museum/Legends|museum]] located in [[Clan Farlook (district)|Clan Farlook]], one of [[Phemiss]] districts. It was presumably named after the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] native [[hiakk tree]].<ref name="CatCW" />
